sources.role: pinned VICE source mirror; VIC-20 machine, SDL UI, snapshots and ROM paths
VICE ROM search path and filenames
xvic one-port native VICE controller contract

paths.naming: VICE resource lines use ResourceName=ResourceValue; SDL xvic defaults to sdl-vicerc.
!CLEAR followed by <device> <inputtype> <inputindex> <action> <params>; JoyDevice1=4+SDL host-device-index. xvic exposes one native joystick port; the SDL virtual keyboard remains VICE-owned.

paths.path: Attached VIC-20 disk/tape images or FS-device directories
paths.naming: Guest program saves retain the attached image or FS-device filename; VICE writes no generic per-game sidecar.

paths.path: ~/.config/vice/VIC20.vsf quick snapshot or a user-selected .vsf path
paths.naming: VICE .vsf snapshot tagged VIC20 and bound to the snapshot module version.

VIC-20 ROM resources include basic-901486-01.bin, kernal.901486-02.bin/kernal.901486-06.bin/kernal.901486-07.bin, and chargen-901460-03.bin (Japanese chargen-901460-02.bin also exists); no canonical checksum is declared by VICE.
No external cryptographic key file is consumed by native xvic.
Same VICE resource syntax under the Flatpak XDG config home.

paths.naming: Same one-port .vjm and JoyDevice1 contract as native SDL VICE.

paths.naming: Guest saves retain the attached media/FS-device naming.

controller_boundary.refusal: Use only the shared native VICE .vjm writer, constrained to xvic's one joystick port; do not use the PET keyboard boundary of xpet or the libretro vice_xvic identity.

notes: xvic is the native VIC-20 binary and is distinct from xpet and from the vice_xvic libretro core. Runtime launch and effective device input remain unverified.
